title: Gaussian Behavior and Geometric Gaps in Decompositions from Recurrences with Zero Coefficients
summary: Zeckendorf's theorem establishes a unique representation for positive integers as sums of non-consecutive Fibonacci numbers. This result has been generalized to Positive Linear Recurrence Sequences (PLRS), where key statistical properties, such as the Gaussian distribution of summands, depend on strictly positive recurrence coefficients. This paper investigates the consequences of relaxing this condition by studying \textit{Zero Linear Recurrence Relations (ZLRRs)}, where the leading coefficient is zero ($c_1=0$).
